changelog:
Initial release of ciderbox.

- Build and manage Apple-native container dev environments from your Mac.
- Run and test code across multiple Linux distro images locally using Apple container VMs.
- Scaffold project configs and run one-off commands in clean VMs.
- Orchestrate local OpenClaw agent swarms with orchard commands.
- Includes commands for config scaffolding, testing, building, diagnostics, and cleanup.
summary: Build and manage Apple-native container dev environments with ciderbox and orchard swarm.
